title: TrustedPublisher
description: A trusted publisher configuration that allows a CI/CD provider to publish a package using OIDC token exchange.

id.description: The unique identifier for this trusted publisher configuration.

repository_owner.description: The owner or namespace of the source repository.

repository.description: The name of the source repository.

workflow_filename.description: The workflow file that is trusted to publish, applicable to GitHub Actions.

environment.description: The deployment environment name, if restricted.

created.description: The date and time the trusted publisher was configured.
